description:
We are looking for a motivated supply chain student to join our semiconductor Supply Chain Planning team on a part-time basis. This is a hands-on learning opportunity to support the planning of a semiconductor supply chain spanning multiple products, working alongside experienced planners and cross-functional teams (engineering, procurement, suppliers, and manufacturing partners).

As a Supply Chain Planning Student, you will help maintain production data, execute production builds, prepare reports and dashboards, track material and WIP status, and support both production planning and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. This is an ideal role for a student who wants to gain real-world experience in a fast-paced, fabless semiconductor environment and grow toward a full-time Supply Chain Planner career path.

The ideal candidate is a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who is comfortable working with data, eager to learn, and able to communicate clearly. No prior professional experience is required — we will teach you the tools and processes.

Key job responsibilities

● Support daily production planning activities and help maintain production plans across multiple product lines

● Collect, consolidate, and organize supply chain data from multiple sources (ERP systems, suppliers, manufacturing partners)

● Build and maintain Excel-based reports, charts, and dashboards (WIP, inventory, shortage, and excess lists)

● Track material status across wafer foundries, assembly/test houses, and contract manufacturers, and flag issues to the planning team

● Assist with NPI planning tasks — help track qualification timelines, pilot builds, and BOM material availability

● Help prepare status summaries and follow up on open items with internal stakeholders and suppliers

● Support release and procurement tracking of BOM components

● Take on ad-hoc analysis and process-improvement tasks that reduce manual effort for the team

Basic qualifications
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree program in Industrial Engineering & Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical / Practical field

Available to work part-time (approximately 2-3 days per week), with flexibility around your academic schedule

Preferred qualifications
At least 3 semesters remaining until graduation (to allow for a meaningful engagement)

Coursework or interest in supply chain, operations, planning, or semiconductor manufacturing

Exposure to ERP systems is an advantage

description:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.

Key job responsibilities

Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services

Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations

Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects

Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services

Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences

A day in the life

As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.

About the team

We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

Basic qualifications
- Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Hebrew at C1 level or above

- Experience with at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)

- Right to work in Spain for the duration of the internship

- Understanding of basic IT systems, software development, or system architecture concepts

Preferred qualifications
- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including security, storage, or databases (relational and/or NoSQL)

- Understanding of operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)

- Interest in or experience with generative AI, for example building with LLM APIs, agents or AI coding assistants

- Experience with systems administration (Linux/Windows), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, load balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)

- Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company
